description: Pre-launch boundary hardening refactor — fix DDD service boundary violations, rewrite REST URL space to canonical org→project→env hierarchy, standardize naming (STITCHD_ env vars, crate renames, Scylla keyspace), consolidate admin UI patterns (Dropdown/Modal/EmptyState/usePaginatedList primitives), migrate admin forms to Formik+Yup, align SDK spec with Rust implementation.
